sources.selection: 55 attack is the exact midpoint; HP/attack double per star under the existing single-player rule. This July row is not claimed to be the May client's base stats.

localAdaptations.critical: One reproducible battle-local roll per legal ordinary attack; skills/periodic/reflection excluded. Evade/immunity consume a roll, but only landed hits count as critical hits. No guaranteed proc interval; no campaign RNG usage.
localAdaptations.openingJump: Assassin role works with one unit, independently of 3/6 critical thresholds. Existing deterministic backline selection, instantaneous timing and adjacent free-cell rule are local adaptations.

burrow.resolution: instant legal adjacent move; no extra invulnerability or concealment; blocked distant landing retains mana
burrow.visuals: existing ImageGen portrait with an independent dive/eruption pose and earth ripples

localAdaptations.summons: Do not inherit personal assassin critical chance, and do not increase the opening formation count.
localAdaptations.bladeThrall: Vanguard personal passive remains an independent 10% roll with 3/4.5/6 multipliers; six assassins do not grant it the assassin trait.
localAdaptations.otherTiers: Other formations retain their existing versioned single-player choices. Wild-beast/vanguard cumulative interpretation and other historical differences remain open work.
